name: Connector toggles
oneLiner: a glass connectors panel of generic app glyphs (mail, calendar, files, chat, tasks): a pointer runs down the list flipping switches green one by one, each glyph wakes from grey as the count ticks, then the count pill lands green with a check and a sheen
say: when the speaker says they plugged their tools into the AI ('I connected my mail, my calendar, my files...', 'flip these on and it can see everything'): each switch flips on a named tool, the count lands on the payoff
